Messages.Author: Beatrice
Messages.Body:
Looking at the decks at the final table it is pretty impressive that Marko managed to come out the winner: He played against two intercepty fighty decks and two stealth voters (packing Ancilla Empowerments). These decks can be the death of his deck.

Combination of a good start (Jake Washington, Travis, Rock Cat, Ossian, Young Bloods and Gregory Winter out at the end of the turn two!!), sub-optimal draws of his predator and prey, favourable table dynamics and, to state the obvious, playing well won Marko the day.
